A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same R&B-POP research. Their readable main texts, equations, figures, tables, and complete supplementary materials support reliable comparison, including matching renumbered appendix content.

before.justification: v1 reports original V2V4Real and OPV2V experiments, detection and label-quality results, ablations, and qualitative analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains those empirical results and adds experiments comparing and combining R&B-POP with 3DIoUMatch, plus a training-data quantity study.

M1.justification: The original ranker, coarse-to-fine refinement, and distance-based curriculum remain unchanged. Section S3.1 adds a hybrid procedure that supplies refined reference predictions from nearby frames to 3DIoUMatch, then optionally applies curriculum self-training to its predictions.

E1.justification: Both versions use V2V4Real and OPV2V for LiDAR vehicle detection, including sensor mismatch, simulation-to-real adaptation, multiclass refinement, and multiple reference cars. The new comparisons and clip-count study reuse this coverage.

E2.justification: v3 newly evaluates 3DIoUMatch (Wang et al., 2021) against R&B-POP in Table S1, alongside combined variants. The existing Luo et al. heuristic refinement and You et al. self-training comparisons remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The new semi-supervised comparison uses PV-RCNN for both approaches and 40 annotated frames. A separate study varies training data across 5, 10, 15, and 20 clips. Existing benchmark splits, metrics, and training settings are retained.

E4.justification: New Sections S3.1–S3.2 test whether refined reference labels and curriculum training complement 3DIoUMatch, and how performance depends on training-clip quantity. Existing ranker, curriculum, crowded-object, multiclass, and multiple-reference analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests for detector performance. Existing descriptive distributions and noise-sampling specifications are unchanged; the new tables also report point estimates.

E6.justification: Matched main and appendix results are unchanged. New v3 Table S1 reports 0–80 m AP at IoU 0.7 of 37.1 for 3DIoUMatch, 41.7 for R&B-POP, and 39.5/44.4 for hybrid variants using PV-RCNN. Table S2 adds a data-quantity trend from 17.1/6.7 AP with 5 clips to 47.1/21.1 with 20 clips at IoU 0.5/0.7.

T1.justification: The loss expressions, threshold formula, and mathematical setup are retained. Neither version contains theoretical proofs, and v3's additional conceptual discussion introduces no new formal assumptions, definitions, or derivations.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same learning scenario, identified challenges, ranker and curriculum contributions, and label-efficiency claims. The headline improvement from 22.0 to 56.5 AP remains unchanged.

C2.justification: v3 interprets the new experiments as demonstrating complementarity with direct semi-supervised learning. Section S1 also clarifies online data collection, offline refinement/training, and standard detector cost during deployment. Existing modality and malicious-agent limitations are retained.

D1.justification: v3 documents PV-RCNN use and the label-selection and retraining procedure for the added 3DIoUMatch experiments. Existing ranker implementation, sampling parameters, hardware, training time, project link, and planned code-release status remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds semi-supervised and offboard detection references, explicitly distinguishes its access constraints from offboard methods, and relates the ranker to existing IoU scoring methods. These additions refine positioning while retaining the original research framing.

P1.justification: Most existing prose is retained. v3 adds an appendix discussion section, separates ranker architecture from training details, inserts two empirical subsections, and updates cross-references, publication headers, and acknowledgments.

P2.justification: v3 adds Tables S1–S2 and retains the previous appendix tables as S3–S7. Some existing tables now sit beside text, figures are resized or repositioned, and spacing is tightened. Existing visual content is largely preserved.

improvement.justification: The new comparison using PV-RCNN for both methods addresses a useful gap in v1: whether reference predictions add value beyond direct semi-supervision with 40 labeled frames. The combination experiments strengthen evidence for compatibility, while the online/offline and offboard-method discussions clarify applicability. These are focused improvements; the added data-quantity study has limited protocol detail, which restricts its evidential value.
